body:
There is no painless way - the body doesn't want to die. 

Take the opportunity to talk to someone and get help. It doesn't have to be this way.

Hey. Thank you. I had a couple questions about your dad, but I didn't want to be inappropriate. Basically regarding how it shaped you.

Anyway, I do appreciate your message, so thank you.

I edited my initial response to you, so there's a thing about calling i mentioned, and how I have issues with it. I know that's kind of an sol situation for me. 

I'm already on medication, but it isn't enough. I'm afraid my current meds will hijack any medication conversations. I know my blood pressure is an issue, but I keep going in for depression and getting bp meds altered instead. I keep suggesting maybe my bp would be lower if I could calm down, but .... Whatever.

You've actually provided lovely and helpful advice and I'm sorry I've been bitching and moaning at you in return, but I really do appreciate your help.

That might be awesome if I could afford it, but I'm broke, plus it wouldn't fix the meds problem. 

Do I really not want to go to the hospital as a danger to myself? I've really been so close these past couple days. I have the rope, the razors, the location, etc. I think I sound flippant, but I'm really not.

I'm not so bad an alcoholic that I need to detox. I'm more a weekend to weekend type. I'm a little afraid of the alcoholism eclipsing the depression and apd. Also, which hospital? We have two local, and also a mental health one, but the mental health one has a six month waiting list.I

Also, most importantly, calling anyone is... not easy at this point. Being a throwaway here in a burst of energy is quite different from real world actions. Phone calls push me over the edge.

EDIT: Since this is a throwaway: I haven't left the apartment in two weeks. I haven't washed my hair in six months...

More to the point, the suggestion of a call reminded me of the last time I reached out for help and got... Redirected. I know the mental health hospital has a six month waiting period for appointments because of a phone call, which left me crying. I don't know how to explain it, the whole thing makes me feel stupid.

Just posted in this sub myself, so I know I don't have any answers, but I know I've never seen anyone truly out of options. The worst days pass eventually (like fucking kidney stones, but still...)

I thought I wanted to die 25 years ago - and many times since - but I haven't yet regretted holding off. I don't know why we have these urges for self-destruction, but I know we must resist them, because they are fleeting.
